response.description:
Perimeter link (cross-perimeter
connectivity) is a network security perimeter capability that allows trusted
resources in two different network security perimeters to securely communicate
with each other using Managed Identity (MSI), without requiring additional network
security perimeter access rules or network configuration changes. It preserves
Zero Trust boundaries while enabling controlled service-to-service access
across perimeters Learn
more.
response.title: Public Preview: Perimeter link feature in network security perimeter
